## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed 420 image captures during June 2026. This report records the activity completed during the month and summarises the quality and grading outcomes associated with those captures. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing the number of images available for assessment and the cases requiring further attention.

## Image quality

Of the 420 captures, 20 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.8 per cent. These images could not be used for grading. The result should be considered alongside routine checks of image capture and any operational issues identified during the month. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 127 referable results from the activity recorded in June 2026. The median grading wait was 2 days. This provides the reported measure of the time between image capture and grading for the month. The results should be reviewed through the usual local monitoring arrangements, with attention to image quality and grading timeliness.
